Title: A2batt Recalls EEMB Lithium Coin Battery Chargers Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Battery Ingestion; Violate Mandatory Standard for Consumer Products with Coin Batteries
ConsumerContact: A2batt by email at info@a2batt.com or online at www.eemb.com/Recall

Products.Name: EEMB Lithium-ion Coin Battery Chargers with Rechargeable 2032 Batteries

Hazards.Name: The recalled battery chargers violate the mandatory standard for consumer products containing button cell or coin batteries, because the charger has lithium coin batteries that can be accessed easily by children. When button cell or coin batteries are swallowed, the ingested batteries can cause serious injuries, internal chemical burns and death.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should stop using the charger immediately, remove the batteries and place them in an area that children cannot access. Contact A2batt to receive a full refund.

Retailers.Name: Online at Amazon.com from August 2024 through March 2026 for about $14.
